nodes.label: Best Trial Survival by Epoch (line chart, log scale): tracks the survival duration in years of the best-performing simulation trial at each training epoch (0-4500). Most epochs cluster tightly around 100-150 years, then a sharp spike near epoch ~4400 jumps to 1,842 years, followed immediately by an outlier reaching >20,000 years, marked against a dashed green threshold line — depicting a rare breakthrough trial in the 847M civilization-trial simulation that far outlives the baseline population.
